census_scvi.label: Census scVI
census_scvi.seen_cells: trained on all primary Census cells, so on every cell evaluated here
census_scvi.used_labels: no cell-type labels; batch covariates: assay, dataset, donor, suspension

geneformer_ft.label: Geneformer (fine-tuned classifier)
geneformer_ft.used_labels: YES: fine-tuned with multi-task supervision that includes cell type, so this is not a zero-shot embedding

tf_sapiens.label: TranscriptFormer TF-Sapiens
tf_sapiens.seen_cells: pretrained on 57 million human cells; overlap with these cells not checked
tf_sapiens.used_labels: no cell-type labels (generative pretraining); inference used the assay
